\chapter{Boolean Analysis — KKL}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Applications.KKL
\section{Overview}
The full variance-scaled KKL theorem and its edge-isoperimetric strengthening give large coordinate influences. A further consequence locates a large nonempty Fourier coefficient at degree controlled by total influence.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[KKL edge-isoperimetric bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.kkl_edgeIsoperimetric}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.exists_sq_div_sum_le_of_sum_three_halves, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance_rpow_ratio_le_noisy_total, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.stableInfluence_one_third, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.maxInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_sq_deg, KKL.noisyInfluence, KKL.sum_noisyInfluence}
\difficulty{5}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with variance $V>0$, and put $a=I(f)/V$. Then $(9/a^2)9^{-a}\le\max_{i\in[n]}|I_i(f)|$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Explicit variance-scaled KKL coordinate bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_influence_ge_kkl_bound}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.ComparisonAux.kkl_scalar_dichotomy, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance_eq_sum_nonempty_fourier, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance_rpow_ratio_le_noisy_total, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.kkl_edgeIsoperimetric, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.maxInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.max_influence_lower_bound, BooleanAnalysis.parseval_pm_one, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_sq_deg}

Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube in dimension $n\ge2$. Some coordinate $i$ satisfies $\operatorname{Var}(f)\log n/(30n)\le I_i(f)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Variance-scaled KKL theorem]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.kkl}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_influence_ge_kkl_bound, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.maxInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne}
\difficulty{5}
There exists an absolute $c>0$ such that for every natural dimension $n$ and every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ under the uniform law, $c\operatorname{Var}(f)(\log n/n)\le\sup_{i\in[n]}|I_i(f)|$, with the empty supremum and division by zero interpreted as zero. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Large nonempty Fourier coefficient]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_large_nonempty_fourierCoeff}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance_eq_sum_nonempty_fourier, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance_rpow_ratio_le_noisy_total, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.friedgut_junta, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_sq_deg, KKL.card_bounded_subsets_le}
\difficulty{6}
There exists an absolute $C>0$ such that for every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ under the uniform law with $\operatorname{Var}(f)\ge1/2$, there is a nonempty $S\subseteq[n]$ with $|S|\le CI(f)$ and $\widehat f(S)^2\ge\exp(-CI(f)^2)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{theorem}
